description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Pohaddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner details, extent of land, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land settlement and title determination processes.
